title: Real label: Barbaresco Riserva
scenario: Read the label in the photo, then answer.

questions.stem: Which element on this label is the **designation**?
questions.explanation: Barbaresco DOCG is the designation. Montefico is the vineyard; Riserva is an ageing term; Produttori del Barbaresco is the producer and bottler.

choices: the village of the bottling agency
the commercial name of the blend
the producer that bottled the wine
the vineyard the grapes came from
questions.explanation: As in the course's *Barolo Bussia*, a vineyard name can follow the designation.

questions.stem: Which grape is this wine made from?
questions.explanation: Barbaresco DOCG, like Barolo, is Nebbiolo from Piemonte.

questions.stem: *Prodotte 16.666 bottiglie* matches which of the seven main label details?
questions.explanation: The seventh detail is the bottling number/sequence — here, how many bottles were made.

questions.stem: Compared with Barolo, Barbaresco is generally less tannic, with more red fruit and faster perfume development.
questions.explanation: Both Nebbiolo DOCGs from Piemonte; Barbaresco is the softer, quicker-developing one.
